business_process: ACMC justice and public safety casework
description: Pretrial and probation supervision, violation tracking, and court date management for 15 criminal justice agencies (CJI), including AG-02
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Officers cannot see release conditions, violations, or warrant status, which can lead to a wrongful arrest or a missed violation; agencies can run about one shift on printed rosters; CJIS availability terms in contracts
manual_workaround: Printed supervision rosters and condition sheets generated nightly; agency message switch terminals for criminal history checks
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-04; agency identity providers
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; state message switches (agency-owned)
dependent_people_or_facilities: ACMC platform operations; SOC; agency officers
quantified_impact_basis: SLA service credits (about $350,000), agency overtime reimbursement claims (about $150,000), and liquidated damages after 4 hours in 3 sheriff contracts (about $400,000)
single_points_of_failure: Integration hub on-premises edge in DC-1 (31 VPN tunnels)

business_process: ACMC revenue and tax compliance casework
description: Audit follow-up, collections cases, and taxpayer correspondence for 6 state revenue agencies (FTI), including AG-01
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract RTO of 8 hours; filing-season peaks; FTI may be restored only into the approved FTI tenants (Pub. 1075 sec. 3.3.1)
manual_workaround: Agencies pause outbound collections notices and use their own tax systems for taxpayer inquiries
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (dedicated FTI database instances); SYS-02; customer-managed keys
dependent_people_or_facilities: ACMC platform operations; Director of Regulated Data Compliance
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits (about $300,000) and delayed collections penalties in 2 contracts (about $800,000). The agencies' own harm (about $14 million a day of delayed state collections) is not a company cost but drives the reputational rating
single_points_of_failure: Customer-managed keys co-controlled by each agency (DEP-23)

business_process: ACMC driver license hearings and suspensions
description: Administrative hearings, suspension and reinstatement casework for AG-05 (DPPA personal information)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reinstatements and hearing dates are time-bound for drivers; DPPA restricts any fallback that copies records outside approved systems (18 U.S.C. 2721(a))
manual_workaround: Hearing officers reschedule; reinstatements processed from the agency's own driver record system
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; AG-05 driver record system

description: Constituent requests, permits, and code enforcement for about 110 counties and cities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Paper intake sustains about 3 days; hurricane season raises demand for constituent requests
manual_workaround: Phone and paper intake; agencies back-enter after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; tier-1 help desk vendor

description: About 640 interfaces: state message switches (CJI), revenue file transfers (FTI), motor vehicle and court systems; 31 site-to-site VPN tunnels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: BP-01 and BP-09 depend on it; queued messages replay after recovery, but criminal history checks stop
manual_workaround: Agencies use their own message switch terminals; files resent after recovery
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (cloud services and DC-1 edge); SYS-04
dependent_third_parties: State message switches; revenue agency transfer endpoints; DC-1 colocation provider
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits across interface contracts and overtime to replay queues
acquisition_or_legacy_dependency: AQ-1 network peering reaches the hub (POAM-004); 7 legacy VPN appliances use FIPS 140-2 modules (POAM-006)
single_points_of_failure: DC-1 edge terminates all 31 VPN tunnels; no second site

description: Application intake, verification tasks, eligibility rules execution, and case maintenance for SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid in 4 states (about 38,000 applications and changes a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SNAP expedited service by the 7th calendar day and normal processing within 30 days (7 CFR 273.2(g)(1), (i)(3)(i)); contract RTO 8 hours; families lose access to food, cash, and medical assistance
manual_workaround: Agencies take paper applications and issue expedited benefits through their own benefit issuance systems; backlog worked after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; document imaging and mail vendor; identity verification service
quantified_impact_basis: Contract performance penalties in 4 IES contracts (about $1.4 million a day after 8 hours), idle operations staff (about $0.7 million), and overtime to clear backlogs (about $0.5 million)
single_points_of_failure: Single print and mail vendor for 3 of 4 states (DEP-14)

business_process: AG-04 Medicaid enrollment and premium processing
description: Managed care enrollment changes and premium payment posting for AG-04 Medicaid enrollees (ePHI; business associate scope)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Enrollment files to health plans run on a monthly cycle with daily changes; HIPAA business associate duties (45 CFR 164.302)
manual_workaround: Agency processes urgent enrollment changes manually through its own Medicaid system
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; AG-04 Medicaid system
quantified_impact_basis: Contract penalties and manual processing cost

business_process: Eligibility contact centers and document processing
description: Contact centers and document scanning and indexing for the 4 IES agencies (about 61,000 calls and 120,000 pages a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Applicants cannot report changes or submit verification; call abandonment penalties in contracts
manual_workaround: Recorded message with agency office information; paper documents held for later scanning
dependent_third_parties: Telephony carrier; document imaging and mail vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Contact center agents; document processing staff
single_points_of_failure: Single print and mail vendor for 3 of 4 states (DEP-14)

business_process: Legacy hosted court and sheriff records systems
description: Managed hosting in DC-1 and DC-2 of court case management (AG-06 and 4 other courts) and 4 sheriffs' records systems (CJI)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Court dockets, warrants, and protective orders; CJIS availability terms; nightly backups give a real RPO of 24 hours against the 1-hour target
manual_workaround: Courts use printed dockets and paper filing; sheriffs use the state message switch for warrant checks
dependent_third_parties: DC-1 and DC-2 colocation providers; legacy backup system
dependent_people_or_facilities: Data center operations; court and sheriff liaison staff
quantified_impact_basis: Liquidated damages in 3 court contracts and service credits
acquisition_or_legacy_dependency: 64 unsupported servers (POAM-005); flat management network (POAM-024); non-immutable backups (POAM-008)
single_points_of_failure: 6 of 9 customers hosted only in DC-1 (DEP-07)

description: Electronic filing for 9 courts, including AG-06 (CJI in criminal filings)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Court rules allow paper filing during outages; filing deadlines extended by court order
manual_workaround: Paper filing at clerk counters; court orders extend deadlines
acquisition_or_legacy_dependency: AQ-1 runs its own identity directory and account, never DR-tested (DEP-10)
single_points_of_failure: AQ-1 cloud account and identity directory

description: Tier-1 and tier-2 support, status pages, and incident notices to agency security contacts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract and CJIS clocks: suspected CJI incidents reported within 1 hour (CJISSECPOL IR-6); agencies must report possible FTI disclosures within 24 hours (Pub. 1075 sec. 1.8)
manual_workaround: Printed agency contact list in the incident binder; out-of-band phones
dependent_third_parties: Ticketing SaaS; telephony carrier; tier-1 help desk vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Customer support (about 380 staff); Director of Regulated Data Compliance
quantified_impact_basis: Contract penalties for missed notice deadlines; the main cost is legal and reputational

description: 24x7 SOC monitoring, triage, and response across all environments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Undetected spread raises every other impact; CJIS and Pub. 1075 logging and monitoring terms
manual_workaround: Second SOC site; manual log review from cloud consoles
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and retained incident response costs
acquisition_or_legacy_dependency: AQ-1 logs are not in the SIEM (POAM-003)

description: Build, test, and release pipelines for ACMC, IES, and AQ-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency security patches for internet-facing services need the pipeline
manual_workaround: Break-glass manual deployment with two-person approval and post-change review

business_process: Federal programs delivery and CUI enclave
description: IT modernization services for federal civilian agencies; DoD subcontract software work in the CUI enclave
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deliverable dates; DFARS 252.204-7012 incident reporting within 72 hours applies if the enclave is affected
manual_workaround: Work continues on agency-furnished systems; enclave work pauses

description: Implementation, data migration, and staff augmentation projects (about 2,600 consultants)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Billable hours; project milestone dates in fixed-price contracts
manual_workaround: Consultants on agency sites keep working on agency-furnished devices
quantified_impact_basis: About 60% of consultant hours unbillable while corporate systems are down

description: Payroll for 12,000 employees; timekeeping that also feeds agency billing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates; state wage payment laws
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll and true up

description: Quarterly close, 10-Q and 10-K preparation, and Form 8-K filing capability
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; at quarter-end the MTD drops to 48 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual close workpapers; filing agent can file from its own systems
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime; the main exposure is a missed SEC deadline

description: Invoicing about 145 agencies and posting payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash timing only; government payment cycles are 30 to 45 days
manual_workaround: Manual invoices from the ERP export
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred cash about $13 million a day; cost is the financing of the delay
